calendar_method: Union of dates with daytime bars (06:00 <= hour < 18:00). Evening sessions map to the next such date; early-morning sessions map to the first such date on or after their calendar date. This is an empirical calendar, not a separately supplied exchange calendar.
activity_definition: Number of trading days with summed observed volume > 0 / all empirical trading days in the available requested window. Days without instrument records are not positive-volume days.
coverage_caveat: Dataset ends 2021-10-18. The remainder of 2021 is unavailable and excluded from the denominator. Short-history instruments are penalized by the common-window denominator.
validation: Independent pandas and DuckDB calculations agree for all 77 files.
Daytime-only positive-volume calculation produces the same set of 42 passing files.
